title: Require Exported Value Declarations To Have JSDoc
forbids: an authored value implementation export in a qualified public resource, provider, or service face without adjacent nonempty declaration-site JSDoc or with an obvious placeholder JSDoc block
why: Exported values cross module boundaries. Declaration-site documentation keeps their owner, purpose, and intended semantics visible through reuse and relocation while review owns semantic quality.
remediate: Delete an unused export or add adjacent nonempty, non-placeholder JSDoc before its defining runtime declaration. Explain purpose, behavior, ownership, or invariants. Document a direct anonymous default value at its export statement; leave type-only and ambient declarations to TypeScript and re-export barrels to inherit documentation from the owner.
message: Exported authored value declarations require adjacent nonempty non-placeholder declaration-site JSDoc.
